title: Realm Taxonomy Discoveries: Causal Information Horizons, Temporal Informational Singularity for Qualia, and Informational as Active Cascade Medium
description: Three adversarial-vetted structural novelties produced via Fold-First Ranking methodology on 2026-08-14. (1) Causal Information Horizons: every causal system contains an irreducible boundary beyond which an embedded observer cannot reconstruct causal relationships, regardless of computational power. (2) Temporal Informational Singularity for Qualia (TIS-Qualia): subjective experience is the signature of irreducible self-referential information in the temporal domain. (3) Informational as Active Cascade Medium: information is not a passive substrate but an active medium that shapes the possibility space of causal cascades. All three novelties were subjected to a four-check adversarial vetting protocol: null-hypothesis defeat, hallucination check, scope minimization, and structural distinctness verification.
